data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 将技能作为外部可复用工件，用配对评估共识提交更新，并以完整优化轨迹选择表示结构，属持续技能自改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: An update is committed only when paired evaluations reach consensus, requiring sufficient overall improvement and non-negative aggregate paired gain in every repeated evaluation.
scope_support.object_quote: In the consensus-gated phase, complementary editing intents generate complete candidate skills.
scope_support.persistence_quote: signals of process and redundancy sensitivity derived from the full optimization trajectory, including accepted and rejected candidates, guide the selection of a flat, graph, or hybrid representation.
